name: v0.3.32 — Reports / Returns / Stores on mobile · CSE rate limit · Connections links everywhere
releaseNotes:
• Three new screens on mobile that previously only existed on web:
  → Reports — monthly spending totals, sorted newest-first, with lifetime total card on top
  → Returns — receipts with open refund windows, sorted by days-left ascending (urgent first)
  → Stores — distinct stores with receipt count + lifetime spend, searchable
• Reachable from the Menu long-press popover (Profile tab).
• Web /api/product-image-batch now per-user rate-limited (6 req/min) + batch cap reduced 80 → 20 names. Protects the Google CSE 100/day free tier from runaway loads.
• Connections link added to web Inbox + Profile headers (was already on Rewards / Stores).
